name: Unwarp
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 1.00). Replaced keyword guess "arbitrary-call".

descriptions.text: The vulnerable contract exposed an unwrapWETH(uint256, address) function with no access control, which would unwrap WETH held by the contract and send the resulting native ETH to an arbitrary caller-specified recipient. Using a Balancer flashloan of ~100.85 WETH, the attacker transferred the WETH into the vulnerable contract, then called unwrapWETH(...) directing the unwrapped ETH (including the contract's own pre-existing WETH balance) to itself, re-wrapped exactly the borrowed amount and repaid the flashloan, keeping the difference (~9k USDT worth). Root cause: missing authorization on a function that releases funds to an attacker-chosen address.
